purpose: TeleportService design: a place script asks for a HISTORICAL Roblox PlaceId; BLOXEN resolves it to a locally held, approved place version or returns a controlled 'unsupported-local-destination' result. Nothing here ever contacts Roblox.
rules: A mapping is 'approved' only if the target local place is registry status PRESERVED and its SHA-256 is pinned here.
A PlaceId with no entry is UNMAPPED. A mapped entry whose target is absent from the local store is UNAVAILABLE. Both return unsupported-local-destination.
Two local files that claim the same historical PlaceId are different VERSIONS; the mapping pins exactly one (by sha256) and the choice is recorded.
The mapping is a BLOXEN design decision (INFERRED); it is not historical data. Historical PlaceIds come from the place files / Archive Team evidence.

entries.why: Classic: Crossroads. Two held versions claim id 1818 (crossroads-2007-client = 2007-era, crossroads-uncopylocked-commit = a later file). The later commit version is the one whose own scripts teleport to other places, so it is pinned for script-driven travel. The alternative is selectable only by its registry id on the Games page.
Archive Team uncopylocked list: 1501 = World HQ.
Archive Team uncopylocked list: 1784 = Mission to the Moon. Accepted with caveat (provenance grade UNKNOWN).
